findings.title: Compliance timeline acknowledged
findings.what: The HireRank design document does not evidence "compliance timeline acknowledged" — it describes an LLM that scores CVs with no human review before rejection emails.
findings.why: CV screening is listed in AI Act Annex III point 4, so provider obligations apply from 2 Aug 2026 under AI Act Art. 113.
